rules.nudge: The same read still reports ENOENT. Recheck the task and exact path before another identical read. Do not create a file unless the user/task independently authorizes that new file.
The edit reports a stale hash repeatedly. Re-read the current target with an allowed tool and reconcile the actual change before retrying; do not overwrite unrelated edits.
The same tool request is denied or unsupported. Respect the restriction: use an already allowed alternative or report the blocker. Never bypass permissions or confinement.

Repeated identical reads have produced unchanged evidence and no intervening reported progress. Check whether the task needs an authorized implementation/check step instead. Polling may be intentional; this is not proof of a defect.

The latest shell outcome is a reported failure, followed by an explicit all-checks-passed claim. Reconcile that failure with the claim and actual required checks before reporting completion. Tool errors are not an approval verdict.

observerGuidance: Missing-file retries do not authorize new files; verify the actual task and path.
Prefer one concrete evidence-backed direction or no-op; do not duplicate a deterministic rule.
